title: Investigate the House of Grief
html:
Investigate the House of Grief is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with  Arves in the Lower City.

Objectives

Investigate the House of Grief.
  • "We found a very disoriented merchant called Arves loitering outside a building. We should find out what happened to him. Maybe they'll have answers inside."
Learn more about the House of Grief.
  • "We entered a strange establishment called the House of Grief that cures people of their grief through a process called 'Unburdening'. It seems suspicious. We should investigate."
  • "We learned about the unique services offered by the House of Grief. Perhaps they're what disoriented the merchant outside."
Find a way into the back room in the House of Grief.
  • "We tried to enter a room in the back of the House of Grief but a guard stopped us. Maybe there's a way to gain entry."
Complete the Mapping of the Heart.
  • "We have agreed to partake in the first stage of the Unburdening - the 'Mapping of the Heart'. It's in the back room."
Investigate the back room in the House of Grief.
  • "We made it into the back room. We should have a look around."
Talk to Viconia.
  • "We learned that Viconia DeVir is running the House of Grief. She wishes to speak to us beneath the building. We should follow the passageway."
Uncover the secret beneath the House of Grief.
  • "We stumbled into a strange establishment with secrets beneath its surface. We need to investigate further."
Surrender Shadowheart to Viconia.
  • "We agreed to surrender Shadowheart to Viconia in exchange for Viconia's support in the fight against the Absolute. We should bring Shadowheart to her."
Fight Viconia and her Sharran cult.
  • "We decided to attack Viconia. Let this be her end."
  • "Viconia wanted us to give her the Astral Prism. When we refused, she decided to take it by force. We need to defend ourselves."
Quest Complete
  • "We made a deal with Viconia. She will support us in the fight against the Absolute."
  • "We defeated Viconia and her Sharran cultists. The people of Baldur's Gate are now safe from her schemes."
  • "We were unable to get to the bottom of the House of Grief's goings on. We must press on."

Walkthrough

A Wandering Merchant

In the northwestern corner of the Lower City, west of the Baldur's Gate waypoint (across the bridge), the party can encounter a confused merchant named  Arves at X: -252 Y: -2. The man appears dazed, and is fixated on a squirrel in a tree. Probing further causes the party to learn that the man's memories have been tampered with.

The party can choose to study the man's appearance to note he is a man of means, possibly a junior council member:

  • [INVESTIGATION] Study the man's appearance. (DC 10)
  • [RANGER] [INVESTIGATION] Examine the man's attire, expression - anything of note. (DC 10 )
  • [ROGUE] [INVESTIGATION] Look the target over, examining him. (DC 10 )

Arves asks the party if they know where he lives, to which the party can say they do not know or that they doubt that he is even from around here. If asked what he does remember, he states he only knows that he was very sad but is not anymore; his memories have been taken.

Up the stairs from Arves is the House of Grief.  Mirie is at the front desk, where she welcomes the party. She asks if the party is here to be unburdened and that she senses a deep sadness within them. The party can agree, to which she charges a 1,000 gold fee.  Shadowheart's presence in the party waives the fee entirely. Mirie unlocks the door to the backroom and tells the party to sit on the bench.

Mapping of the Heart

The Mapping of the Heart begins once the bench is sat on. An Inquirer of Grief appears and begins asking questions. With a successful Perception check, the interacting party member realizes that the Inquirer is using  Detect Thoughts to probe through their thoughts. Selecting "Drop the act. You're not here to help - you're trying to dig around in my thoughts." ends the Mapping prematurely. If continuing to answer the questions, the party is diagnosed with either a  Craven Heart,  False Heart,  Jealous Heart,  Melancholy Heart,  Prying Heart, or  Violent Heart.

After the Mapping, the Inquirer lowers her hood and reveals herself to be  Viconia DeVir, the Mother Superior of the  Shar enclave. She wants to speak to the party further, so she invites them to enter a hidden door in the room to talk further in the building.

If Shadowheart is in the party and sits on the bench, Viconia foregoes the Mapping and reveals herself, telling Shadowheart she has much to discuss. Shadowheart is always diagnosed with a  Wayward Heart.

Speaking to Viconia

Entering the hidden door transports the party to the Cloister of Sombre Embrace. Deep within the cloister they find Viconia with a group of Sharran cultists. She reveals that she knows the party carries the artefact and that she needs it to destroy the Absolute. Viconia first tries to negotiate to keep blades sheathed:

  • All right, you wish to negotiate? Make me an offer then.
  • As far as the artefact is concerned, there's nothing to discuss.
  • Attack
  • Turn to leave.

Selecting the first option has Viconia demanding the artefact in exchange for the party's lives. The party can counter:

  • Shar will allow you to make such an offer?
  • This must be truly important, if Shar would allow you to make such an offer. Why do you want it?
  • [INTIMIDATION] Not happening. Even if I wanted to give it to you, I can't. The artefact is bound to me. It will kill you. (DC 20)
  • [PERSUASION] The artefact alone can't save you. Best if we unite against a common enemy - the Absolute. (DC 20)
  • Attack.

If the Intimidation or Persuasion checks are passed, then Viconia relents. However, she demands that Shadowheart be handed over. The party can either agree, which starts ⁠Surrender Shadowheart to Viconia, or refuse, which starts a fight against Viconia and her followers. Defeating Viconia or giving Shadowheart over to her resolves the quest.

If Shadowheart has left the party permanently before (and is considered  Dead), Viconia complains that it should have been her who killed Shadowheart. She then attacks the party, unless they succeed on a  DC 30 Persuasion Check.

Quest Rewards

  • If Shadowheart is given over to Viconia, then Viconia and the Sharrans are enlisted as allies in ⁠Gather Your Allies.
  • If Shadowheart is now a Dark Justiciar of  Shar, she replaces Viconia as the Mother Superior. The same support in Gather Your Allies is then provided by Shadowheart instead.
  • ⁠Knives in the Dark ( Soldier backgrounds) - if the sharrans are all killed.

Notes

  • This quest heavily intersects with Shadowheart's personal quest, ⁠Daughter of Darkness; bringing Shadowheart along is encouraged, as doing so allows for unique dialogue and interactions.
  •  Jaheira and  Minsc have special interactions with Viconia if they are in the party when meeting her.
    • In the room where the Mapping of the Heart takes place, they comment on the reunion.
    • If Viconia is defeated in combat in the Sharran Cloister, is spared by the party and then spoken to, Jaheira/Minsc tell her how she lost her way.
    • Choosing to spare Viconia earns approval with Jaheira; choosing to kill her earns approval with Minsc.
